snippet.title: Neko Bento | Announcement Trailer | Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
Your perfect, cat-themed lunchbox puzzle is here!
Bored with the food you take to work every day? Do you wish it was more… meowtastic?
Neko Bento will let you put together your own, perfect lunchbox. Here, your food will be made by a hardworking cat-chef, and fitting in all the snacks will require your puzzle-solving skills.

Don't forget to follow us on

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/RedDeerGames
